Content settings control paragraph lines, list markers, emphasis, tables, and inline heading images

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "crawlberg.h"

int main(void) {
    CBERGAlefHandle config_handle = cberg_crawl_config_from_json("{\"content\":{\"bullets\":\"*\",\"compact_tables\":true,\"extract_metadata\":false,\"keep_inline_images_in\":[\"h2\"],\"list_indent_width\":4,\"strip_newlines\":true,\"strong_em_symbol\":\"_\"}}");
    CBERGAlefHandle engine = cberg_create_engine(config_handle);
    cberg_crawl_config_free(config_handle);
    char url[2048];
    snprintf(url, sizeof(url), "%s", "https://example.com");
    CBERGAlefHandle result = cberg_scrape(engine, url);
    if (result != 0) cberg_scrape_result_free(result);
    cberg_crawl_engine_handle_free(engine);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
